rows.note: Use this for allotting work or another task to someone; it is the all-purpose choice for this task sense.

example.english: The manager will assign the new task to us.
example.traditional: 經理會分配新任務畀我哋。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 wui5 fan1 pui3 san1 jam6 mou6 bei2 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this for designating or setting aside a particular thing, time, or place for a purpose.

example.english: The company will assign this room for use as a meeting room.
example.traditional: 公司指定呢間房做會議室。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zi2 ding6 ni1 gaan1 fong2 zou6 wui6 ji5 sat1

rows.note: Use this when assigning a particular person to a post, role, or duty rather than formally appointing them to office.

example.english: The supervisor will assign Ming to handle this project.
example.traditional: 上司指派阿明負責今次項目。
example.jyutping: soeng6 si1 zi2 paai3 aa3 ming4 fu6 zaak3 gam1 ci3 hong6 muk6

rows.note: Use this for formally appointing someone to an office or official position.

example.english: The government will formally assign him to the post of director.
example.traditional: 政府正式任命佢做新任局長。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 zing3 sik1 jam6 ming6 keoi5 zou6 san1 jam6 guk6 zoeng2
